relationships.subject: Paeonol
relationships.evidence_quote: The analgesic effect of PAE administration was associated with suppressing the enhanced expression of HMGB1

relationships.subject: Paeonol
relationships.evidence_quote: PAE treatment significantly ameliorated mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia of mice induced by complete Freund's adjuvant (CFA)

relationships.subject: glycyrrhizin
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibition of HMGB1 activity by glycyrrhizin (GLY), an HMGB1 inhibitor, alleviated CFA-induced pain and also facilitated PAE-mediated analgesic effect in mice

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, we showed PAE exerted analgesic effect through inhibiting the HMGB1/TLR4/NF-κB p65 pathway and subsequent generation of cytokines TNF-α and IL-1β in the ACC.

key_findings: Paeonol relieves CFA-induced hyperalgesia and suppresses HMGB1, TLR4, nuclear NF-κB p65, TNF-α and IL-1β in the ACC
HMGB1 inhibitor glycyrrhizin alleviates CFA pain and enhances paeonol analgesia
